entries.title: The project pill stays out of the way
entries.body: With one project set up, the top bar no longer shows the All projects pill; your personal workspace gets a pill only while the Tasks panel lists one of its tasks. Opening the pill no longer dims your crewmates on its own: a project lights up only once you move the pointer onto its pill.

picture.alt: The open project row in the top bar with every crewmate on the stage still fully lit
